id.description: Unique identifier for the {@link UiApDataStore} instance.

dataId.description:
Identifier for the specific data to request from {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap}.
If none is provided, all actions in the action map will be triggered.

additionalArgs.description:
Additional arguments to be merged with the existing action arguments.
These will be deeply merged with the existing action arguments, and the {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap} will
be updated accordingly.

merge.description:
Whether to merge the fetched data with existing data (true) or replace completely (false).
When true, new data is merged with existing data. When false, new data replaces existing data.

doNotUpdateArgs.description:
Whether to update the args of the {@link #dataId}'s action.
When true, the args will not be updated. Only applicable when {@link #additionalArgs} are provided.

title:
Specification for requesting data from a {@link UiApDataStore}.

This type is used to configure data requests in the data store. It allows components
to specify which data to fetch and any additional arguments or merge behavior.
name: UiApDataStoreDataRequestSpec
